_comment: Per-group, per-data-type default model. Single source of truth for both generate_group_dashboards.py (sets the dashboard's $model dropdown default) and alert_service.py (selects which model to evaluate for SMS alerts). Edit this file to change defaults; alert_service re-reads it on every check cycle (CHECK_INTERVAL_SECONDS).
_fallbacks: alert_service falls back to 'tide_astro' for groups without a 'tide' entry.
